verdict.rationale: Parsec's downloads page lists clients for Windows, macOS, Linux (Ubuntu 22.04), Android, and a Chrome web client, and hosting runs on both Windows 10+ and macOS 10.15+. That covers the main desktop platforms plus Android, and implies mixed-OS host/viewer pairings. Missing for 10: any iOS/iPadOS client evidence, an explicit statement that cross-OS host/viewer sessions are supported, hosting on Linux, and independent or hands-on confirmation of cross-platform use.
